summary_en: FY3/27 annual dividend forecast raised ¥6 to ¥67/share (ordinary ¥55 + special ¥12). Mid-year dividend ¥39 (ordinary ¥27 + special ¥12); year-end ¥28 (ordinary ¥28). Special dividend increased from ¥6 to ¥12 due to higher-than-expected gains on sale of investment securities.
title_en: Notice regarding revision to dividend forecast (dividend increase) for FY3/27
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, Shofu Inc. announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2027. The annual dividend per share has been increased by ¥6 to ¥67/share (from the prior forecast of ¥61/share made on 13 May 2026). The annual dividend comprises ordinary dividends of ¥55/share (¥27 at mid-year, ¥28 at year-end) and special dividends of ¥12/share (¥12 at mid-year). The increase in special dividends from ¥6 to ¥12 reflects gains on the sale of investment securities that exceeded initial expectations. The company maintains a dividend policy targeting a consolidated payout ratio of 40% or higher and a dividend-on-equity (DOE) floor of 3.0%, with dividends paid twice annually (interim and final).
